title: Key EU-US trade deal in limbo amid tension as US threatens extra tariffs
summary: "In politics as in business – a deal is a deal. And when friends shake hands, it must mean something.” Ursula von der Leyen's comments came amid growing tension between Europe and the US over Greenland and France's membership at Trump's Board of Peace, which led the European Parliament to suspend the ratification of the EU-US deal struck last July.
